findings.rationale: Top-level icon used by iOS has transparent corners and 21.84% non-opaque pixels; native requirement expects square artwork without transparency.
findings.required_fix: Create opaque platform-appropriate iOS icon, preferably 1024x1024, configure platform-specific icon, and test it.

findings.rationale: Android adaptive foreground reuses a masked circular badge reaching canvas edges; over 52% of opaque pixels are outside the guaranteed 66/108 safe zone.
findings.required_fix: Create transparent unmasked owl foreground inside safe zone with separate cream background and update tests.

findings.rationale: The 1200x630 social card is not suitable splash artwork and defaults to an illegible ~100x52.5 render.
findings.required_fix: Create dedicated transparent official splash mark, set explicit imageWidth/background, and update tests.

handoff: Phase C must fix only the three native asset/config blockers, then rerun full test gate and isolated D.
